completion_rule: Run S0 numerical replay diagnostics and complete S1, S2, and S3 on the frozen 15 inner folds; perform the preregistered analyses; freeze one development candidate specification; stop without outer-test access or additional candidates.

S0.action: read existing targeted_ablation_20260828 R2 predictions, metrics, checkpoints, logs, overflow counts, and preprocessing metadata
S0.architecture: original R2 concat of 514-dimensional deep embedding and 32-dimensional PCA statistical embedding followed by the existing dropout and Linear(546,2) classifier

S1.name: R2-FP32
S1.fusion: raw concat 514+32 then existing dropout and Linear(546,2)

S2.name: R2-NormFusion
S2.fusion: LayerNorm(514, elementwise_affine=true) on deep embedding and LayerNorm(32, elementwise_affine=true) on statistical embedding, concatenate to 546, then the unchanged R2 dropout and Linear(546,2) classifier

S3.name: R2-GatedFusion
S3.fusion: g*d + (1-g)*s, then the same classifier dropout probability and Linear(64,2)

s0_overflow_diagnostic_replay.reason: Historical S0 artifacts contain overflow counts but no per-layer gradients or activation-scale attribution, so bounded diagnostic replay is necessary.
s0_overflow_diagnostic_replay.scope: one deterministic first training epoch for each of the 15 frozen inner-train folds
s0_overflow_diagnostic_replay.precision: AMP float16 with the same GradScaler initialization and optimizer
s0_overflow_diagnostic_replay.optimizer_steps: same as S0 for the bounded diagnostic epoch, but diagnostic outputs are never used as model candidates or checkpoints
records: GradScaler scale before and after update
global gradient norm before and after clipping

threshold_protocol.cross_fitted: For a held inner validation fold, fit the balanced-accuracy threshold using only the other two disjoint inner validation folds in the same outer context.

candidate_selection_rule.numerical_stability_requirement: zero nonfinite FP32 loss or gradient and zero skipped optimizer steps
candidate_selection_rule.S2_retention: Retain S2 over S1 only if S2 has either mean paired BA >= +0.01 with at least 9/15 nonnegative BA folds, mean paired AUROC >= +0.01 with at least 9/15 nonnegative AUROC folds, or train-validation BA gap reduction >= 0.03 without BA or AUROC decreasing by more than 0.01.
candidate_selection_rule.S3_retention: Retain S3 only if it improves mean paired BA or AUROC by at least 0.01 over the best simpler stable candidate with at least 9/15 nonnegative folds, the mean gate is within [0.10,0.90], and disabling the deep branch reduces BA or AUROC by at least 0.01.
candidate_selection_rule.fallback: If S2 and S3 do not meet their retention rules and S1 is numerically stable, recommend S1.

forbidden: outer-test loading, prediction, evaluation, threshold selection, or model selection
new fusion candidate beyond S2 and S3
FFT-band, MIL, Hard Top-K, activity-attention, bilateral-fusion, temporal-BatchNorm, preprocessing, sensor, wrist, or activity changes
